typeface.note: Conversation prose: Claude sets Latin text in the serif face and lets Chinese fall through to a sans CJK — the serif Latin faces carry no CJK glyphs, so the stack leads with serif and names the sans CJK families after it. The interface keeps the sans stack; only Markdown prose uses this.

typeface.note: Claude's lockup is drawn in Anthropic's serif, so its rows take the same face; the serif token stays behind it so a missing font degrades to the shipped serif.
The host reads these through a `font:` shorthand that names --dsw-font-family directly, so overriding the `-font-family` sub-tokens never reached the page: the shorthand itself has to be re-declared.

apex.note: Claude Desktop's strong running-title peak; the base ink remains the theme's primary text.

The effort ramp takes the theme's accent hue: its weak end mixes that accent toward the raised surface, lowering the saturation and the contrast while the hue stays the reader's choice. The strongest end in --dsh-claude-effort-high mixes the same accent toward the label ink on each appearance.
The effort ramp's strong end: the theme accent deepened toward the label ink, so the rung order reads through lightness and saturation without leaving the theme's hue.

tokens.use: the standard edge: card and panel outlines, dividers, field outlines
tokens.note: The dark edge is a highlight, not a contour: a translucent white ring reads as the top light catching a chamfer and composites over whatever fill it lands on, where an opaque colour has to be re-picked per surface. The three dark rungs are that one highlight at .09, .18 and .30; the light rungs stay the warm opaque ladder, since on a light canvas an edge is a shadow.

tokens.use: a line that only separates: foot areas, settings rows, menu separators, the transcript's rule
tokens.note: One rung below the lightest border: a separator marks a change of subject, not the edge of a surface, so it stays quieter than the outline it sits inside. The dark rung is the border ladder's highlight at a lower alpha, the light ones a wash of the ink at .05.

tokens.use: the single accent: checks, focus rings, selected marks

tokens.note: The host takes a primary button's fill from --dsw-alias-brand-primary but its hover from a monochrome step of its own scale, so both steps are stated here and the hover stays in the fill's family.
Card-specific, like the solid hover chip: in light the host paints this surface lighter than the canvas, and the light ink it carries needs a light fill.
